questions.question: The review body also flagged #1131's description: its commit and file counts predate #1137, and the CHANGELOG checkbox is wrong. Merging #1138 adds a 7th commit, so the counts change again. When should I rewrite the description?

options.label: After #1138 merges (Recommended)
options.description: You squash-merge #1138, and I then re-derive the commits, shortstat and verification from the new head and rewrite the body once. Its counts are true the moment they are written.

options.label: Now, counting #1138 ahead
options.description: I rewrite the body now with 7 commits and the expected diff. The counts are false until you merge, and they would need redoing if #1138 changes.

options.label: Leave it to you
options.description: I post nothing. You edit the description yourself, from the figures I report here.

questions.question: The 6 threads now carry 'Fixed in #1138' replies, but the fixes reach #1131's head only when #1138 merges. When should I resolve the threads?

options.label: After #1138 merges (Recommended)
options.description: A resolved thread then always means the fix is on #1131. I resolve all 6 in one batch, in the same pass as the description rewrite.

options.label: Resolve now
options.description: The 6 threads close right away. Until you merge, the fix exists only on the side branch.

questions.question: How should #1131 close the gap where deleting @restates from the .als/.lean files passes every CI job?

options.label: Checker R4 (Recommended)
options.description: check_formal_trace.py gains R4: a file under sdd/formal/alloy/ or lean/ with no @restates line fails. Reaches docs-gate, lint and verify-formal, locally and in CI. Test seen failing first, mutation-checked. The docstring's 'gets R1 only' sentence and README § Traceability tags change. Side PR into store-model-axioms.

options.label: Widen tooling-tests trigger
options.description: ci.yml: add ^sdd/formal/(alloy|lean)/ to tooling-tests' trigger (new filter output). The guard stays a pytest test, so it runs only in CI's tooling-tests job and in local `fast`/`test` runs, not in docs-gate.

options.label: Both
options.description: R4 in the checker plus the CI trigger. Belt and braces; larger diff touching ci.yml, which itself matches CODE_PAT and makes the side PR run every code job.
